hookText: POV: You caught the manor's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: I was tiptoeing through the shadows, my tallow candle trembling in my trembling hands, when I saw her. She was as still as a statue, her arms raised above her head, as if she was stretching out the night. The moonlight filtered through the window, casting her in a ghostly glow. I couldn't help but admire the grace in her movements, even if they were in the service of the manor.
caption:
Caught my new maid in the quiet corridor. What do you think she was thinking?
